card.name: Linking word after an age number
card.fires_on: The small word (or, and, with) right after an age figure such as 65 years or age 40, where the next word is older, younger or greater. Also words just before the word age.

modes.label: Age cutoff phrases
modes.description: The word "or" or "and" after a number in phrases like 65 years or older.
modes.example: may be more prevalent in a population of 65 years<< or>> older.

modes.label: Before the word age
modes.description: A linking word or punctuation just before age as a risk factor.
modes.example: This risk increases<< with>> age and the number of cigarettes you smoke

card.writes: It promotes the word age and its forms, so it helps predict age wording next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word after an age number, where the text is about to say older or younger.
